messages:
oliver: Heads-up — found a weird provisional charge in the console for a streaming session that did a tool_call and then the stream truncated. user saw a fallback to another region and the provisional tokens are credited to the fallback route, but final billing shows different attribution. attaching repro snippet below.

sara: ugh. streaming + tool_call + truncation + region fallback — that's a messy intersection. do you have the request id? :eyes:

mike: can you paste the routed headers? wondering if route_hint was lost during the handoff.

oliver: request id sess-0x9f7a. here's the internal payload we saw at proxy (sanitized):

```
{ "session_id": "sess-0x9f7a", "client_route": "eu-west-1", "route_hint": null, "model": "rw-3b-opt", "tool_call": {"name": "search", "attempt": 1}, "streaming": true }
```

and proxy logs around the moment of fallback: 

```
[2026-02-15T14:02:11Z] proxy: session sess-0x9f7a accepted on eu-west-1
[2026-02-15T14:02:12Z] runtime: stream truncated at seq 16384 -> triggering region fallback
[2026-02-15T14:02:12Z] router: selected fallback us-central-1 (capacity)
[2026-02-15T14:02:12Z] proxy: forwarded session sess-0x9f7a to us-central-1 (route_hint lost)
[2026-02-15T14:02:13Z] runtime-us-central: tool_call(search) retried attempt=2
```

jen: that log line `route_hint lost` is the smoking gun. if route_tag header is dropped, the console provisional ledger probably credited tokens to the active route (us-central). then the final engine billing reconciles back to eu-west once the tool_call completes and credits resolve, which explains the mismatch.

mike: agreed. two separate issues to fix: (1) ensure route_hint header is preserved across fallback path, (2) console UX should show "provisional by route" vs "final by route" and surface when fallback occurred. otherwise SRE/customer sees wrong provisional numbers and gets alarms.

sara: for (1) i'll add a router test that simulates mid-stream handoff and asserts X-Route-Hint persists in proxy->runtime handshake.

jen: for (2) UX ask — can we add a tooltip on the provisional line: "Provisional totals reflect tokens attributed at time of completion; fallbacks may be re-attributed on reconciliation." also add an event link to the fallback id so ops can jump to the handoff trace.

billing-bot: FYI: created billing-inc-1423 to track reconciliation rule impact (labels: provisional-attribution, fallback-route).

oliver: thx. one extra oddity: the tool_call retry on fallback increments attempt and emits a separate provisional credit in ledger with merchant_tag="tool_search-bg-embed" which isn't the same tag we use for primary route. that makes automated reconciliation harder.

mike: annoying. suggest normalizing provisional tags to include original route/session metadata (e.g., "sess-0x9f7a|eu-west-1|tool:search|attempt:2") so the ledger dedupe can find matches after reconciliation.

jen: good call. i'll sketch a lightweight tagging RFC and add an example mapping for console display.

oliver: small repro playbook I used (if useful):
1) open streaming chat to eu-west-1 with a tool_call that hits the search backend (low cap).
2) artificially throttle eu-west runtime to force truncation -> router fallback.
3) observe provisional credits in console, then final diff after reconciliation window (~30s).

sara: perfect. i'll own the router test and the e2e repro harness. mike/jen — can you own the ledger tag normalization + console tooltip?

mike: will do. adding telemetry note: emit `fallback.event=true` and `original_route=...` to provisional ledger entries so we can query for these incidents.

jen: will wire the tooltip and event link. also add a small console banner on accounts impacted by >1% provisional drift due to fallbacks.

oliver: great, thanks all. leaving the repro harness outputs in #eng-platform-debug for anyone who wants raw logs. :thumbsup:
